hypotheses.J1_form_independence: The five normalized output-conditioned quadratic forms have Gram effective rank at least 4.
hypotheses.J2_shared_input_geometry: Median rank-4 subspace overlap is at least ten times the random-subspace expectation.
hypotheses.J3_noncommuting_forms: The median pairwise normalized commutator norm is at least 0.05, ruling out a single exact neuron-aligned eigenbasis.
hypotheses.J4_compact_shared_subspace: A shared 32-dimensional input subspace captures at least 20% median Frobenius energy of the five full forms.
hypotheses.J5_semantic_retention: The shared 32-dimensional quadratic representation stays within 0.05 median AUROC of the full form on every corpus.
hypotheses.J6_cross_terms_required: In the frozen shared-subspace basis, off-diagonal cross terms contain at least 25% median restricted-form energy at dimension 32.
